question: Should `vincentkoc` be the sole actor authorized in code to dispatch crawl-remote Access reconciliation while deployment activation remains separately controlled?
rationale: The patch intentionally decides who may initiate privileged Cloudflare and cross-repository GitHub credential mutations; correctness tests cannot establish repository authorization policy.

options.title: Approve named authority
options.body: Accept the hard-coded login and actor ID as the intended bootstrap authority while retaining the separate deployment controls.

options.title: Use repository-governed authorization
options.body: Replace the person-specific gate with an approved environment, team, or equivalent repository-controlled authorization mechanism before merge.

options.title: Pause the bootstrap
options.body: Keep the workflow dormant and unmerged until the permanent credential-rotation ownership model is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve named authority
recommendation.body: Accept the hard-coded login and actor ID as the intended bootstrap authority while retaining the separate deployment controls.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the implementation history and is the operator encoded by the proposed authorization contract.
